description: Valid ID3v2.4 tag with a TIT2 of 130 bytes (syncsafe $00 00 01 02, 258 as a plain integer). Read as plain, TIT2 jumps into the data of the PRIV frame behind it, where a TPE1 header and zero bytes make a chain that also ends exactly at the end of the tag. The syncsafe reading is consistent, so it is the one used.
